entry_conditions: ps00, ps01, ps02 independently accepted and integrated; foundation-accepted true.
Pin actual integrated SHA, contract versions, fixture/oracle/budget/dependency revisions before creating a runtime task.
lease_policy: Parent task holds the module lease and executes its checkpoints serially. Checkpoint IDs are not runnable board tasks or additional leases. For intra-module parallelism, replace the parent lease with separately scoped disjoint tasks and a module integration owner.
file_map_policy: Paths are proposed feature groups, not created files, public API locks or ownership grants. Follow the M0-approved API layout and the exact parent task scope. Do not read this entire catalog into each agent context.
handoff_required: actual file map and code-size/exception report
commands, exit_codes, test_counts, skips and negative cases
